title: Same sense of electio — synonymous with praedestinatio
source_text: XX. Et eodem quoque sensu vocem Electionis usurpant. Siquidem per Electionem intelligunt decretum, quo Deus ab aeterno quosdam homines ab aliis selegit, ut illos in hac vita gratiae Christi participes redderet, in altera vero gloria coronaret; adeo & electio & praedestinatio pro Synonymis ab ipsis habeantur.
pass_a_gloss: And they also use the word Election in the same sense. For by Election they understand the decree by which God from eternity selected certain men from others, that He might make them partakers of the grace of Christ in this life, and in the other crown them with glory; so that both election and predestination are held by them as synonyms.
pass_b_english: Same group: electio = decree selecting some for grace now, glory later.
Electio and praedestinatio treated as synonyms.

choices.term: adeo & electio & praedestinatio pro Synonymis ab ipsis habeantur
choices.english: so that both election and predestination are held by them as synonyms
choices.why: Locks electio to the same good-sense package as XIX.
rejected: these Doctors keep electio strictly wider than praedestinatio
